topic: Reconcile conflicting supplier delivery dates and inventory records across fragmented ERP export (Postgres), Logistics Ticket API, and Risk Feed without fabricating missing data.

zetaris.query: SELECT supplier_id, order_id, promised_date, status, source_system, freshness FROM supplier_cross_silo_sync

transcript.content: Hey team, I ran a cross-silo comparison across our suppliers. We have a direct conflict on SUP-8021 (Acme Global): ERP records promise delivery on 2026-11-01 as 'Shipped', but Logistics Ticket API (2h freshness) and Vendor Risk feed (6h freshness) both report delivery delayed to 2026-11-14 due to a port strike. The ERP snapshot simply hasn't ingested the carrier exception yet. @CloudArchitect, how should our ingestion handle this freshness delta?
